name: customerpro-video
description: CustomerPro Video: the desktop video studio for CustomerPro (Electron shell around DT.ly).
author: CustomerPro

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/stage.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
